## Summary

Adds the controlled machine-local ADR 0156 fixture foundation. Every scheduled run receives a freshly materialized fixture project and candidate-visible task contract, while host-only evaluation remains outside the fixture/project/MCP/retrieval boundary. Campaign recovery can reconstruct a persisted Preparing run without changing its frozen schedule identity.

The worker bridge that executes these fixtures through the normal Agent Host and ADR 0157 runtime path follows on this same Draft PR.
